method: GPT adjudication of frozen explicit review findings and authored public-prefix regressions; no automated bidding-quality oracle

Competitive opener raises can promise only three cards; later responder continuation must not claim opener guaranteed four or publicly guaranteed an eight-card fit.

The one-level fourth-suit exception 1C-1D-1H-1S explicitly shows four natural spades, forcing one round for an unpassed responder.

Cheap one-level new-suit advance of a natural overcall can show four cards.
Strong two-club original-major game return retains its public five-card minimum instead of inventing six; shared length fix belongs to core agent.
Six-card or longer quality overcalls may reduce usual HCP thresholds by suit quality and cashing tricks; no universal lower point threshold was added.
